* IkeAuthPayload is an abstract class that represents the common information for all Authentication * Payload with different authentication methods. * *

Authentication Payload using different authentication method should implement its own * subclasses with its own logic for signing data, decoding auth data and verifying signature. * * @see RFC 7296, Internet Key Exchange * Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2)
